::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 11th [1852]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Huntington Library: Yonge Letters
:::

My dear [Madam](people/person_1243.qmd),
I send your pretty little [garland](other_books/otherbook_225.qmd) for October, hoping it will find you improved in health

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
